arguments.decision_needed: The tenant says the LG washing machine supplied with the flat has a power failure and cannot be fixed. They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost; it would remain their property, not be on the inventory, and they would take it when they leave. Please decide: (a) consent to the tenant fitting their own machine, and say who pays to disconnect and remove the existing machine and fit the new one, and what should happen to your LG (inspect, repair, dispose); or (b) we send our contractor to inspect/repair; or (c) you arrange your own contractor.
options: Consent to tenant's own machine; state who pays for removal of the old one and fitting, and what happens to the old LG
Agency contractor inspects/repairs or replaces the landlord's machine

arguments.body: Hi, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Fitting your own machine needs the landlord's consent, so we've put your offer to them, including that the new machine would stay yours and go with you when you leave. We've also asked who covers removing the old one and fitting the new one. Please don't remove or dispose of the current machine until we confirm. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 30 July.

arguments.note: Tenant wants to replace landlord's LG washer with own. Not a repair; needs landlord consent. Tenant's machine stays theirs, not on inventory, removable at end of tenancy. Asked landlord who pays disconnect/removal/fitting and what happens to the existing LG.

arguments.decision_needed: The tenant says the LG washing machine supplied with the flat has a power failure and cannot be fixed. They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost; it would remain their property, not be on the inventory, and they would take it when they leave. Please decide: (a) consent to the tenant fitting their own machine, and say who pays to disconnect and remove the existing machine and fit the new one, and what should happen to your LG (inspect, repair, dispose); or (b) we send our contractor to inspect/repair; or (c) you arrange your own contractor.
options: Consent to tenant's own machine; state who pays for removal of the old one and fitting, and what happens to the old LG
Agency contractor inspects/repairs or replaces the landlord's machine

arguments.body: Hi, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Fitting your own machine needs the landlord's consent, so we've put your offer to them, including that the new machine would stay yours and go with you when you leave. We've also asked who covers removing the old one and fitting the new one. Please don't remove or dispose of the current machine until we confirm. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 30 July.
